subject: Pair project brief — submission window & reviewer slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@gmail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pair project brief — submission window & reviewer slots

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the interview next week. Attached is the short pair-style take-home we use to evaluate engineering candidates for the Inference team. High-level: a 3–4 hour exercise with two parts (implementation + short writeup).

Key details:
- Deadline: Monday 22 Jun 2026, 11:59 PM PT (submit via email or the upload link below).
- Expected time: ~3–4 hours (we do not expect a production-grade system).
- Deliverables: code repo (zip) + brief writeup (PDF).
- Submission options: reply to this thread with attachments OR upload to this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cpairproject

We’ve also included a small sample dataset (sample-inputs.csv) to speed local testing. 

Review process: two internal reviewers will each run the exercise and provide scored feedback within 3 business days after submission. Dev and Lauren — can you confirm reviewer availability below? Ideally we’d book 2x 60-min review windows between Tue/Wed next week so feedback is ready for loop-back.

Attachments: [pair_project_brief.pdf (PDF), sample-inputs.csv (CSV)]

Samira — please reply to confirm you received this and let us know if you need an extension (we can be flexible for scheduling conflicts).

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@gmail.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pair project brief — submission window & reviewer slots

Hi Camila —

Received, thanks — I’ll look through the brief today and aim to submit by the deadline. Quick question: the sample dataset includes anonymized user ids; is it okay if I subset the data (e.g., drop sessions with <3 events) for the local run, as long as I document it in the writeup?

Best,
Samira Patel

Camila —

I can take one reviewer slot. Proposed times (we can split across two reviewers):
- Tue 23 Jun, 09:30–10:30 PT (my preference)
- Wed 24 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PT

Lauren — can you confirm if you can do Tue afternoon or Wed morning? Marcus — pinging you in case you can cover a second reviewer.

Also thinking: for consistency, let’s use the scoring rubric in the brief and add a short code-read checklist (readability, tests, edge-case handling). I’ll draft that if folks agree.

Thanks everyone — quick update and final plan.

Samira: yes — subsetting the sample data is fine as long as you document the change in the writeup. No need to resubmit full dataset. If anything unexpected comes up and you need an extension, flag it here and we’ll accommodate.

Reviewers: confirmed slots:
- Dev Patel: Tue 23 Jun, 09:30–10:30 PT
- Lauren Bishop: Tue 23 Jun, 11:00–12:00 PT
Marcus — thanks for offering to be backup; I’ve added you to the calendar as optional for both blocks. Calendar invites are going out now: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=pair-project-review-slots

Samira — please submit by Mon 22 Jun 11:59 PM PT (reply-to-thread or upload to the Drive link). Once we receive the submission I’ll confirm reviewers have the materials and will schedule the 60-min review sessions.

Attachments reiterated: [pair_project_brief.pdf, sample-inputs.csv]

Looking forward —
Camila Reyes
Sr. Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
